All three questions are answered and `./answer.json` is written with the required schema (list-valued answers plus token logging).

**q1 — Market Research Report for CoachForce (author + key reviewers):** The `products/CoachForce.json` file uses the internal codename "CoFoAIX" (its planning channel is `planning-CoFoAIX`, and the meeting series transitions from `CoFoAIX_planning_*` to `product_dev_CoachForce_*`), so the CoFoAIX-named reports inside it are the CoachForce product's reports, not a distractor product — no other file contains them. I selected the latest version, `latest_cofoaix_market_research_report` (2026-04-19). Its author is **eid_890654c4** (Julia Smith), and the key reviewers are the 7 meeting participants from `CoFoAIX_planning_1` (2026-04-15) who each gave concrete feedback in the transcript — their suggestions match the feedback items incorporated in the latest report verbatim: **eid_99835861** (Ian Jones), **eid_50da4819** (Hannah Miller), **eid_ee9ca887** (George Miller), **eid_8df92d08** (Julia Garcia), **eid_85a4de81** (Julia Davis), **eid_965867b8** (George Jones), **eid_59bbe6f6** (Charlie Smith). I did not include non-contributing attendees or acknowledge-only repliers.

**q2 — Insights on PersonalizeForce's competitor strengths/weaknesses:** Three competitor products (TailorAI, PersonaAI, SmartSuggest) are discussed in `products/PersonalizeForce.json` slack. Five team members posted substantive insights (strengths and/or weaknesses) — the rest only asked questions, thanked the group, or shared unrelated links: **eid_5318af37** (George Williams — TailorAI strengths, SmartSuggest weaknesses), **eid_fce6544f** (Charlie Brown — PersonaAI weaknesses), **eid_c9c3d8d5** (Julia Martinez — SmartSuggest strengths), **eid_d2f0f99a** (David Davis — PersonaAI strengths and weaknesses), **eid_a253c65a** (Hannah Brown — TailorAI weaknesses).

**q3 — Demo URLs shared for PersonalizeForce's competitor products:** Three demo URLs were shared by team members in slack and also appear as competitor entries in the `urls` section: `https://personaai.com/demo` (PersonaAI), `https://smartsuggest.com/demo` (SmartSuggest), `https://tailorai.com/demo` (TailorAI). I excluded PersonalizeForce's own demo videos (`sf-internal.slack.com/archives/PersonalizeForce/demo_1..6`) and blog/article links as out of scope.

All output employee IDs were validated against `DATA/metadata/employee.json`. The `tokens` fields contain estimated per-question consumption since no exact usage counter was available.
